about.title: About
about.tagline: Everything you watch, in one window.
about.lede: Live TV, movies and series on your desktop. Start a room and watch in sync with friends, split the screen across four channels at once, and use the app in Arabic, Kurdish or English.
about.heading: Built for how people actually watch
about.sub: Not a list of checkboxes — every one of these ships in the app today.
about.langSub: Every screen, every message and every date. The layout flips to right-to-left, and numbers, runtimes and relative times follow the language you picked.
about.liveT: Live TV with a real guide
about.liveD: Kurdish and regional channels, sorted by category, with a now-and-next programme guide and a progress bar for whatever is airing.
about.vodD: Browse trending, top rated and now playing, jump by actor, and move to the next episode with one key — season rollover included.
about.togetherD: Create a room, share the link, and everyone stays frame-synced. Chat, GIFs, images and a voice channel are built in.
about.multiD: Multi-view splits the window across several live streams — a match on one tile, the news on another, audio wherever you want it.
about.kidsT: Profiles and a real kids mode
about.kidsD: Separate profiles behind a PIN. On a kids profile the filtering is enforced on channels and titles alike, with a badge so it never looks broken.
about.mediaD: Play, pause and skip from AirPods, Bluetooth headsets or the keyboard's media keys — including live streams, where seeking has to follow the buffer.
about.syncD: Position is saved while you watch and synced to your account, so an episode you paused on one machine resumes on the next.
about.socialD: Add friends by username, send invites straight into a room, and keep private chats without leaving the app.
about.licence: MIT licence — free and open source
about.tmdb: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
